children: Overview
Canada discount retailer's fiscal Q2 sales rose 17.6%
EPS for fiscal Q2 rose 11.2%, beating analyst expectations
Company repurchased 1.6 mln shares for C$300.4 mln during the quarter
Outlook
Dollarama raised fiscal 2027 Canadian comparable store sales growth guidance to 4.0%-4.5%
Company increased Canadian net new store openings guidance to 65-75 for fiscal 2027
Dollarama expects a net loss for the Australian segment in fiscal 2027
Result Drivers
AUSTRALIA IMPACT - Full quarter of Australian operations contributed to sales growth but lowered overall gross margin and increased operating expenses
CANADA STORE GROWTH - Expansion of store network and comparable store sales growth in Canada drove revenue
DOLLARCITY CONTRIBUTION - Higher net earnings from Dollarcity joint venture supported overall profitability

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 12 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the discount stores peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Dollarama Inc. is C$215.00, about 29.9% above its September 15 closing price of C$165.50
The stock recently traded at 30 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 33 three months ago
